# Per-package license exceptions.
#
# Some packages state no machine-readable license in their metadata (an npm
# package's `license` field in package.json, a PyPI distribution's
# `License-Expression`), so the SBOM scanner reports NOASSERTION, yet ship a
# LICENSE file whose terms a human has verified. Each entry here supplies that
# verified SPDX id.
#
# Two guardrails keep this honest:
#   1. An exception is applied ONLY when the scanner reports no license. If a
#      future version declares a real (possibly copyleft) license, it is detected
#      normally and the exception does not mask it.
#   2. The supplied SPDX id is still checked against allowlist.txt — an exception
#      can only rescue a package TO a permissive license, never past the policy.
#
# Format: <package-name> <SPDX-id>   # note incl. source of truth + review date
#
# A trailing `*` on the name is a prefix wildcard (as in allowlist.txt). Use it
# only where the package name is not stable by construction — a generator that
# embeds a content hash in its output name — never to blanket a family of
# third-party packages.

# PyPI, required by Together's library (the worker image has every provider's).
# Its metadata names a license file and no license. That file, in the wheel as
# detect_agent-<version>.dist-info/licenses/LICENSE, is the Apache License 2.0
# text; the project is Together's, github.com/togethercomputer/detect_agent.
# Read at 0.6.0, 2026-10-10.
detect_agent Apache-2.0
